data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 17.538 million in 2018, as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This contrasts with narrative text on page 15 which states a net favourable prior year development of GBP 42.8 million, attributed to a benign period for catastrophe events and favourable development on attritional losses. The 2017 Political Risks & Political Violence segment had previously experienced a GBP 28.9 million loss due to claims activity and reserve strengthening.
